text_block_list.text:
She seemed a bit drained, and upon closer 
inspection, there were dark circles under 
Special Week's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I had a dream where a bunch of 
giant carrots in armor got mad at me, 
shouting, "Eat your daikon too~!"...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't sleep because of that... Even 
though I love daikon radish so much, I 
wonder why...

It seemed Special Week was troubled by 
this mysterious dream for quite a while...
